description: Defines the 'TaskItem' entity class with properties for task details and an enum 'TaskStatus' for task states within a task management API project.

classes.name: TaskItem
classes.description: Represents a task with properties such as Id, Title, Description, Status, DueDate, AssignedToUserId, AssignedToUser, CreatedAt, and UpdatedAt.

classes.name: TaskStatus
classes.description: Enumeration defining possible statuses for a task: Todo, InProgress, Done.

methods.name: Guid.NewGuid
methods.description: Generates a new unique identifier (GUID) for the task item.

methods.name: DateTime.UtcNow
methods.description: Fetches the current UTC date and time.
